verdict.rationale: A live probe with the standard pipeline user agent got HTTP 200 on wyobiz.wyo.gov, landing keylessly on the public Business Center page with no bot wall. Guidance text from several sos.wyo.gov pages (home, Business, MaintainBusiness, Forms, StartABusiness) was extracted as readable content, which suggests server-rendered pages rather than a JS-only shell. The 404 probes on sos.wyo.gov returned ordinary HTTP responses, not challenge pages. Missing for 10: an explicit status/UA probe record for the sos.wyo.gov guidance pages themselves, breadth checks beyond a single GET, and an explicit confirmation that no CAPTCHA or JS rendering is required.
